name: boiled leather
enchant_note: Wax-boiled leather holds a little magic, no more.
protection_note: Cuir bouilli: leather boiled in wax and shaped hard, so an edge skids on it.
protection_price: Catches fire, and fire scorches it.
lore_descriptor: dark and nearly rigid, boiled in wax until it knocks like wood
first_pickup_chronicle: Found a coat of boiled leather. Somebody dunked it hot until it set nearly as hard as bone. It smells like a soup that fights back.
design_notes: Mid-band leather pf 30. Mild AC bump (+1) from the rigidity.
